interfaces.plan_geometry_requests: policy(du-geometry-policy/1 Mapping) x windows(Sequence[Mapping]) x *, page_count:int, limits:{max_pages,max_requests}, work_budget:WorkBudget -> du-geometry-plan/1 (fair class quotas + plan-time borrowing + hard balance; atomic partial plan on budget exhaustion)
interfaces.admit_geometry_request: plan, state, *, page, window_keys, tabular_evidence(observed_candidate|absent|unknown), remaining:int -> (du-geometry-admission/1 decision, next du-geometry-plan-state/1); pure, input state never mutated; dedup per (scope,page); per-use content-digest verification
interfaces.new_admission_state: plan -> fresh du-geometry-plan-state/1 in-call JSON value bound to plan_digest
interfaces.summarize_admission_state: plan, state -> du-geometry-run-summary/1 (reason_counts, not_arrived, spent, class_spent, window_admissions)
interfaces.work_budget_protocol: read-only reuse of company_wiki.document_understanding.layout_hints.contract.WorkBudget/WorkBudgetExceeded; no budget class copied; no reset; no per-page new budget

root_integration_steps: POLICY card compiles du-geometry-policy/1: rule_key = stable SHA of the rule's canonical content (not section_role); every rule carries a COMPLETE geometry_intent (missing fields become conservative unknown plus POLICY_INTENT_MISSING diagnostics); priority=1 never implies fine
ROOT matcher binds windows (window_key/scope_id/rule_key/physical_start/end/native_navigation_refs/navigation_status); each page event must pass ALL covering window_keys of ONE parent scope
plan = plan_geometry_requests(policy, windows, page_count=<pdf pages>, limits={'max_pages': <fine-page cap>, 'max_requests': <request cap>}, work_budget=<ROOT's single WorkBudget for the round>)
state = new_admission_state(plan); for each observed physical page call admit_geometry_request(..., tabular_evidence=<observed_candidate|absent|unknown>, remaining=<caller's remaining allowance>)
on interruption JSON-serialize plan+state and continue identically (test_c proves decision-for-decision equality with a one-shot run)
end of round: summarize_admission_state(plan, state) for the causal summary (not_arrived = reserved pages that never arrived)
ROOT keeps ownership of native navigation, section matching, single TextPage, production source calls, and final wiring; planner never imports matcher/parser/model code
